Clarkston Justice Court was established in 1786 in New York. It has four town justices serving four four-year terms and one chief court clerk. This court is considered one of the most significant courts for criminal cases. This court serves the community of Bardonia, Central Nyack, Congers, Nanuet, New City, Rockland Lake, Valley Cottage, West Nyack, the Village of Upper Nyack in its entirety, and parts of the Village of Nyack and the Village of Valley. The justice court handles and solves criminal, civil, vehicle, and traffic offenses, landlord-tenant, small claims, town code violations, and environmental law violations. It is a jam-packed court.

Division:

Clarkston Justice Court division consists of the followings:

  • Criminal Division
  • Drug Court Division
  • Landlord-Tenant Division
  • Small Claims Division
  • Vehicle and Traffic Division

How to do Case Search:

Clarkston Justice Court Case Search can be done in the following ways:

  • Searching using name
  • Searching using ticket number
  • Searching using the case number
  • Searching using case type
  • Searching using the scope ID number

How to make payment:

Clarkston Justice Court payment can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can make payment by visiting the court during business hours and paying in cash or with a card at the counter.

Online

A person can pay online by using the www.paycourtonline.com website. Convenience charges are applied through an online method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check to the court's mailing address. The mailing address is 20 Maple Ave, New City, NY 10956, United States.

Which cases are handled by the Small Case Division?

Clarkston Justice Court's small claims division is a particular part of the justice court, designed firstly to be used by laymen. It deals with all the cases that involve money claims up to $3000 that person will sue another person. A person can handle these cases without hiring a lawyer, but if you need guidance, you can hire an attorney.

Which type of information is required by the summons for small claims cases?

Information required for small claims are:

  • Defendant Name
  • Defendant Address
  • Plaintiff Name
  • Amount of Money for which you are suing another person 
  • Statement defining your claims that are clear and concise 
  • Address and Phone Number of plaintiff
  • The declaration that you read all the information by placing the initial here.

Which cases are handled by the criminal division?

Clarkston Justice Court's criminal division deals with criminal and civil matters affecting that town's citizens. It handles and solves cases of murder, kidnapping, disputes, and many more.

Which cases are handled by the Traffic and Vehicle division?

Clarkston Justice Court Traffic and Vehicle division handles the case of traffic violation matters. It hears and solves cases involving speeding tickets, accidents, broken vehicles, driving while using mobile phones or drugs, license issues, and many more. This court issues the Speeding tickets. You can hire a professional attorney for these types of cases.

Which cases are handled by the Drug Court?

Clarkston Justice Drug court is a specialized designated court for the services and utilization to reduce drug abuse and drug addict offenders. This court program takes the total weight of interveners to support, forcing the offenders to deal with the drug problems and their effects. The drug court is influential and provides benefits to the people.

Who is an Appropriate Candidate for Drug Court?

The district court chooses an appropriate candidate for drug court, and they:

  • No history in the sales of drugs
  • No violent and felony crimes contribution
  • Drug addiction diagnosed
  • Not on probation period
  • Rockland County resident

How can online hearing be done?

Clarkston Justice Court introduces virtual court due to coronavirus. In a Virtual hearing, the court uses teams to connect with the case person and all judges, attorneys, or others. You had to fill out a form for an online hearing, and a link to the schedule was provided. A person must have a team account and a strong internet connection. It is recommended to join the session half an hour before the schedule. Contact the public defender if you need any information.

Phone: 845-638-5660

Which programs are conducted by the court for the Students?

Clarkston Justice Court Scholastic Program is introduced by the court for high school students. It introduces a criminal justice program for social justice students or scouts who are considering a legal career or want to study the court system or law generally. Contact Candyce Draper for any information.

Phone: 845-639-5973

What will the Reduce Underage Drinking program do?

Clarkston Justice Court had a task force that would do a program to reduce underage drinking. This program will cover the civil responsibilities of parents and allow their children to operate motor vehicles. This program aims to stop people under 21 from using drugs, alcohol, etc. Contact the court community policing unit for any information.

Phone: 845- 639-5800

How can a person get a marriage license?

Clarkston Justice Court Clarkston will provide the marriage license. The fee for the license is $40. The couple's age must be 18+, and they must fill out the form and bring a passport, birth certificate, or anything that can prove their identity. The license is valid for up to 60 days, and a marriage ceremony is held in court after getting it.

FAQ

What are the certified copy fees for birth and death certificates?

The certified copy fee for birth and death certificates is $10.

How can I contact the Town Clerk?

Visit the court from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Monday to Friday or call them at 845-639-2010.

What is the Landlord-Tenant Division?

Clarkston Justice Court Landlord-Tenant Division deals with all the cases where the jurisdiction for the landlord to sue to evict the tenant is unlimited. The property which a person is suing must be within the town area.

What are small claim case court fees?

Small claim case court fees are $10 for claims up to $1000 and $15 for claims greater than $1000.

Who prepared the small claims guide?

Justices of the Town of Clarkstown Justice Court prepared the small claims guides.

What are jury trial fees?

A clerk's jury fees of $10 and $50 for the undertaking file are paid if you demand a jury trial.
